Commentary.Commentary: Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the ring.

Ashley Nurse was the pick of the bowlers as he ended with the figures of 10-0-62-4, his best-ever! Apart from him, Jason Holder and Alzarri Joseph were the ones who kept it tight in the middle overs but then got taken apart in the death overs. The fielding was once again very ordinary. The Men from the Caribbean have a target of 309 in front of them. It's a gettable target looking at the pitch, but they will need a good start from their openers. And mind you, West Indies have never chased a target in excess of 300. We will be back with the chase shortly.

A collective effort from Pakistan sees them end on a high note. After being put to bat, their openers got off to a flier. They stitched an 85-run stand before Kamran Akmal departed, missing out on his fifty. His opening partner Ahmed Shehzad however made sure he got to that landmark. He was involved in another 50-plus stand, this time with Mohammad Hafeez. The hosts did well to choke runs in the middle but then Hafeez and Shoaib Malik let loose, added 89 runs for the 4th wicket with both of them getting to their respective half centuries.
Very full and outside off, Wasim jams it towards mid off for a single. PAKISTAN END ON 308/5.
Yorker outside off, jammed towards cover for a single.
Shortish around middle, pulled to long on for a single.
Very full around middle, dug out down to long on for a brace. Highest ODI score at this venue now.
Shortish around middle, gets back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Shortish around middle, Sarfraz flat-bats it towards wide long on for a brace.
JASON HOLDER to bowl the final over.

Low full toss outside off, mistimes the slog towards long on. Once bounce to the fielder as the batsmen take a single. 300 comes up for Pakistan, first time that this mark has been breached at the ground since the 2007 World Cup.

FOUR! Cheeky stuff! Length ball closer to off stump, Sarfraz makes a bit of room and plays the dab very late. Gets it wide of the keeper and it's too fine for third man to even come across. Another boundary.
FOUR! SLOPPY STUFF! Sarfraz slashes it uppishly towards third man where Lewis makes a mess of a usual stop to concede a boundary. Cannot afford to do such stuff in international cricket.
Fuller on the stumps, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish outside off, Imad looks to cut it away but makes no contact.
Back of a length outside off, tapped to point for a sharp single.
SHANNON GABRIEL comes on to bowl his last over.
Flatter outside off, tapped to cover for a single. Career-best figures for Nurse. Good effort on a fine batting surface.
Fuller on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss and it's swept through the leg side for a single.
Floated around middle, gets across and sweeps it through backward square leg for a brace.
Flatter outside off, Ahmed flat bats it back to the bowler.
IMAD WASIM is the new man in.

OUT! NURSE HAS HIS FOURTH! Malik perishes in pursuit of quick runs. Floated around off, he goes for the slog sweep but gets a top edge that skies down to long off where Holder takes a comfortably running to his right from long on. A fine knock from Malik comes to an end.
Floated outside off, gets back and pushes it to point for a single.

SIX! Oh no, you cannot bowl that sort of lollipops at the death, Mr.Holder! Full toss and Malik swivels to clout it comfortably over deep square leg for a maximum. Runs are flowing at the moment. 39th ODI fifty for the veteran, it's been a gem that has infused lot of momentum in the innings.
FOUR! SLAMMED! Short of a length around middle, swivels and launches this pull over mid-wicket. Another boundary to Malik, brilliant knock this as the finisher. He is toying with the bowlers here.
West Indies are way behind their over rate and so Jason Holder is seen running back to his run-up mark after each delivery.

FOUR! Gets it away this time! Not off the middle though but Malik won't mind it. Fuller ball outside off, he tries to carve it away square on the off side but gets a thick slice past short third man for a boundary.
Slower bouncer around middle, Malik backs away to manufacture a glide past short third man but is beaten by the lack of pace.
Shortish outside off, Sarfraz steers it down to third man for a single.
JASON HOLDER comes back on.
Drifting in from outside off, Malik steps out to that one and blocks it solidly.
Floated outside off, leans into it and blocks well.
Malik steps out and Nurse fires it wider outside off. He offers his pads to that one.
Flatter ball on the stumps, punched down to long on for a single.
Fuller around off, drilled down to long on for a single.
SARFRAZ AHMED is the new man.

OUT! HAFEEZ HOLES OUT! Floated around middle, he charges down the track to hoick it over mid-wicket. Doesn't quite get the desired distance on the lofted stroke and Walton near the ropes takes a regulation catch. Nurse has his third scalp, probably the only WI bowler who is having a smile today. Ends a good knock from Hafeez and a fluent 89-run stand that has upped the momentum.
ASHLEY NURSE is back.
FOUR! BANG! Fuller ball outside off, Malik stays slightly leg side of the ball and pumps it inside out over the covers. Clean strike and it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, Hafeez blasts it down to long on for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, crunched down to long off for a brace.
SIX! LAUNCHED! High full toss and Hafeez helps it on its way over deep square leg for a maximum. Nicely done. He hopes for the no ball call for height but it isn't given. He isn't amused at all.
Very full and around middle, Hafeez looks to flick but gets a faint inside edge on to the pads.
Fuller ball on middle stump, Malik whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SHANNON GABRIEL comes back on.
Very full and outside off, Hafeez digs it out towards cover.
Back of a length around off, makes room and pats it to point for a sharp single.
FOUR! Cleverly done! Back of a length outside off, third man is in the ring and Malik deftly places it wide of the fielder to get a boundary. Nice shot!
Fuller on middle and leg, gets across and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slips it down the leg side, Hafeez misses the flick and that's a wide.
On middle and leg, clipped towards backward square leg for a single.
Good length angled in on off, worked towards mid-wicket.
JASON HOLDER is back.
FOUR! Swatted away! Shortish on off stump, Hafeez stays back and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket to find the fence. He's in top gear now and eyeing to finish with a flourish.
Length ball around off, defended well from the crease.
On middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to point for a quick single.
Slower bouncer around off, Hafeez is early into the pull and misses.
FOUR! This is poor bowling! Full toss and to make matters worse, it's down the leg side, Hafeez just had to get a bit of bat on it. Does so and tickles it well past short fine leg for a boundary.
Floated around middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Two Byes! Fired down the leg side, Hafeez misses the sweep and Hope misses it too. The batsmen run a couple.
Floated around middle, driven down to long on for a single.
50-run stand between Hafeez and Malik.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Drifting in around middle, Malik uses his feet and powers it over mid-wicket. Clean strike and it goes to the fence for a boundary.
Floated around off, bunted firmly back to the bowler.
Fuller on middle, worked away on the leg side for a single.
ASHLEY NURSE is back.
FOUR! Gets it away fine! Back of a length around leg stump, Malik rises on his toes and works it gently past short fine leg. Finds the fence to perfection. Smart batting.
On middle and leg, Malik gets an inside edge through backward square leg. Good running gives them a brace.
Back of a length outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Length ball on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Short of a length around off, gets back to that one and blocks well.
Length ball around off, driven down to long on for a single.
ALZARRI JOSEPH is back on.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle.
SIX! Full outside off, Malik just tonks it over long off for a biggie. That's hit as clean as a whistle. Every run from now on scored by Malik will hurt West Indies and all eyes will turn to Gabriel.
Fuller and angling in, defended with soft hands to mid on. Hafeez takes on the man present there and completes the single.
Hafeez charges down the track and flicks it uppihsly off his pads over square leg. Gets a couple.
Wide! Down the leg side, Hafeez looks to tickle it but misses. A wide is called.

DROPPED! Fullish delivery, angling in, Malik clips it off his pads straight to Gabriel at backward square leg. It's a simple catch but the quickie makes a mess out of it. That's really poor from the hosts. Malik gets a reprieve. How costly will this drop prove to be?
Fuller length delivery outside off, angling in, Malik closes is face of the bat way too early. Gets a leading edge to mid off.
On the shorter side of the length, worked to mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Hafeez stays in the crease and places it towards backward point.
Full outside off, Malik leans into the shot and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Length delivery outside off, guided past point for a single.
On a length outside off, sliced through point for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Malik goes after it with a wild slash but misses.
Length delivery, dabbed to backward point.

SIX! Hafeez on the charge! Tossed up outside off, Hafeez gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the bowler's head. Times it so well that the ball goes all the way into the sightscreen. 15 runs off the over, best of the innings so far!
Tossed up outside off, spins in sharply, Hafeez does well to get his bat down in time.
FOUR! Similar delivery, same shot and the same result! Again it's wide outside off, Hafeez waits for it and and then guides it through backward point for a boundary.
30th ODI fifty for Hafeez!
FOUR! Nicely done! Shortish delivery outside off, Hafeez makes room, allows the ball to come towards him and then guides it with a horizontal bat to the right of short third man for a boundary.
Served outside off, spinning in, punched to long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Malik stays low to cut but misses.

FOUR! A much-needed one! Another short delivery, Hafeez gets across and connects his pull this time. Cuts the two fielders in the deep in halves and the ball races to the fence. That will release some pressure.
Two Leg Byes! Short and angling down leg, Hafeez goes through with his pull but misses. The ball goes off the chest past keeper. It runs fine down the leg side and a couple of leg byes are taken.
Full outside off, driven to deep covers for a single.
Full outside off, Hafeez crisply drives it to deep covers for a single.
Fullish outside off, Malik gently pushes it in covers, takes off for a quick single and completes it.
On a length outside off, Malik prods forward to defend, gets it off the outer half of the bat towards covers.
SHANNON GABRIEL comes back on.
Spinning into the batsman, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SHOAIB MALIK walks out in the middle.

OUT! NURSE GETS HIS SECOND! The pressure was building up and Azam had to up the tempo. But in the end, crumbled under it. Tossed up outside off, Azam covers his stumps, kneels down and sweeps it uppishly towards Joseph at backward square leg, who jumps to complete a decent catch. West Indies have come back superbly in these middle overs.
Short delivery outside off, punched to backward point for a single.
Fuller on middle, eased to long on for a single.
Once again Hafeez charges down the wicket, pats it to long on for a single.

NOT OUT! Hafeez survives! He steps down the track, Nurse spots it again and bowls it flat ans short. Hafeez adjusts and looks to defend, gets it off the inside edge to the right of Hope, who collects the ball and takes off the bails. Hafeez seems to be struggling to get back there. The umpires go upstairs and the replays show that Hafeez makes is just in time.
Hafeez misses his shot and Hope has taken off the bails quickly. The umpire has gone upstairs for a stumping appeal.
Fullish delivery on middle and off, flicked to right of mid on for a single.
On a length and angling in, bounces a touch extra. Azam defends it beside the track and takes a single.
Pitched outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Pakistan have to up the tempo now. They haven't hit a boundary since the 26th over!
Back of a length delivery, angling down leg, Azam works it over square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, tapped back to the bowler.
Banged in short outside off, angling in, Azam ducks under it and lets it sail through.
Short delivery around off, Hafeez camps back and pulls it through square leg. A good fielding in the deep sees some runs being saved for the hosts. A couple taken.
Fuller on middle, clipped in front of square on the leg side for a single.
In the air... but safe! Tossed up on middle, spinning down leg, Azam kneels down to sweep. Gets a top edge and the ball lobs over short fine leg. A brace is taken.
Served around off, spinning in, turned to short mid-wicket. Another dot.
Spinning into the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Hafeez steps down the track, Nurse spots it and serves it slower, shorter and wide outside off. Hafeez adjusts and defends it down the track.
Back of a length outside off, Azam gets on his toes and defends it into the surface.
Short delivery outside off, pulled over towards deep mid-wicket. Just a single taken.
Angling into the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Pitched on a fuller length outside off, defended from within the crease.
Banged in short, angling in, Azam ducks under it and lets it go.
On a length outside off, dabbed past point for a single.

NOT OUT! Azam makes it in time! Another hesitation between the two! Full delivery on the pads, clipped in front of square on the leg side. They complete a single and then take off for the second. However, Hafeez then sends Azam back. The throw is at the striker's end but it's a touch far. Hope grabs it and has to reach out to remove the bails. The umpires go upstairs and the replays show that Azam just makes it in with a desperate dive. The calling has been poor between the two and they need to improve it before it's too late.
Run out referral against Azam. He has put in a dive but this could be touch and go. Perhaps, Hope was a touch late to whip off the bails.
Shortish delivery, spinning into the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Spinning into the batsman, played with the spin to mid-wicket. Azam wants the single but is sent back.
Loops it up, Hafeez dances down the track and gently pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
Tossed up outside off, milked to long off for a single.
Low full toss outside off, eased to deep covers for a single.
Drinks has been taken!
Length delivery outside off, guided to third man for a single.

ALMOST A CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Fullish delivery outside off, angling in, Hafeez looks to flick it but is early into his shot. The ball goes off the leading edge past Joseph, who tries his best, stretching his left arm but fails to get to the ball.

Miscommunication in between! Fuller length delivery outside off, Hafeez looks to defend. Gets an inside edge onto the pads and towards covers. Both the batsmen take off for a single but then decide against it.
On a length outside off, worked to mid-wicket. Three dots in a row.
Length delivery outside off, punched to point.
Length delivery, angling in, Hafeez moves across to tuck but misses and the ball goes off the thigh pad beside the pitch. Hafeez looks for the single but is sent back.
ALZARRI JOSEPH is back on.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flighted around off, blocked solidly off the front foot on to the track.
Floated on a length outside off, Hafeez looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Fuller and outside off, leans into it and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Fired in on the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly short outside off, stays back and cuts it past point for a single.
Wide yorker outside off, Hafeez fails to put bat on ball.
Fuller outside off, Hafeez takes a step down the track and pats it back to the bowler.
Hafeez's struggle against Gabriel continues. Fuller ball outside off, tries to drive without footwork and is beaten all ends up.
Fullish and closer to off stump, pushed down the track to the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Full and outside off, leans forward and defends it well.
Drifting in around middle, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
BABAR AZAM is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! This was on the cards, wasn't it? Shehzad in an attempt to up the ante charges down the track to the off break but misses the heave altogether. Hears the death rattle of timber behind him and he has to go. Decent effort from him but not sure if the pace of scoring was acceptable. Could have definitely scored more quicker but he has given Pakistan a fairly good platform.
Fired down the leg side, Shehzad shuffles across to flick but misses. Wide called.
Fuller around off, driven down to long on for a single.
GOOD STOP! Very full outside off, Shehzad squeezes it towards backward point. Just short of Carter who covers the bad bounce to make a fine stop. Single taken.
Drifting in around off, Shehzad charges down the track for a big hoick but gets an inside edge on to the back thigh.
Floated around leg stump, worked away to deep square leg for a single.
ASHLEY NURSE is back on.
Shortish outside off, Shehzad cannot beat the man at backward point.
Back of a length outside off, glided down to third man for a single.

Needless from Carter! Back of a length outside off, dabbed gently towards the short third man region as they go for a quick single. Hafeez was always going to make it but Carter tries a shy at the keeper's end. Direct hit and he is lucky that it didn't rebound away for overthrows.
Shortish and outside off, Shehzad cuts it well but straight to the fielder at backward point on the bounce.

JUST OVER COVER! Fuller and outside off, Shehzad throws his bat at this tone. Gets it off the toe end and clears the infield at cover to get a brace. Probably wanted to go straighter down the ground with mid off up in the circle.
Back of a length outside off, Hafeez taps it with soft hands towards the off side. They scamper a single before the point fielder comes in to stop the ball.
Flatter leg break outside off, a touch short and Hafeez cuts it to deep point for a single.
Fuller around middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Loopy outside off, Hafeez dabs it towards point for a quick single.
50-run stand between Shehzad and Hafeez.

FOUR! THE RELEASE SHOT! Much-needed as Hafeez was getting into a shell. Not timed that well but will get a boundary. Drifting in around middle, he went for the slog sweep and miscued it over mid-wicket. Nobody in the deep and it was a boundary once it went over the infield.
Flighted outside off, crisply driven towards cover. Cannot find the gap.
Floated wider outside off, could have been a wide but Shehzad reaches it and hacks it through point for a single.
Good length outside off, Hafeez goes back to leaving the ball alone once more.
BEATEN! Finally Hafeez goes for a wild drive to a fuller ball but misses. Looked like a shot out of frustration more than anything else.
Rameez Raja on air is miffed with the batsman leaving balls alone, that too thrice in a row. Mind you, we are in the 25th over.
Shortish outside off, yet another leave from Hafeez.
Back of a length outside off, another leave from Hafeez.
Length ball outside off, Hafeez doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Shortish outside off, gets back and steers it towards backward point where the fielder gets a hand on it. Slows it towards the deep as the batsmen get a single.
Loopy around middle, gets across to sweep but mistimes it just past square leg for a couple.
Floated around middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Floated around middle, paddled towards short fine leg for a quick single. Wild throw at the bowler's end and the batsmen sneak the second as well off the overthrow.
Drifting in around middle, uppish sweep towards deep square leg. Shehzad will get a brace for it.
Loopy on a length outside off, gets back and dabs it towards backward point. Single taken.
Floated outside off, leans forward and drives it to long off for a single.
CLOSE SHAVE AGAIN! Full and wide outside off, uppish square drive just to the right of a diving Carter at backward point. Single taken.
14th ODI fifty for Shehzad.

FOUR! EDGED BUT SAFE! Full and wide outside off, Shehzad drives with hard hands and gets a thick edge that just eludes a diving Hope to the third man fence. It's been a solid innings so far but he needs to bat through and increase the pace of scoring.
Full and outside off, creamed towards sweeper cover for a brace. Gabriel could have shown more awareness to the throw at the bowler's end as it could have made things very interesting.
Back of a length outside off, mistimes the back foot push to the off side.
Length ball outside off, Shehzad gets back and jabs it towards point.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
SHANNON GABRIEL is back.
Fuller on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, Hafeez stays back and steers it towards backward point.
Drifting in from around off, pushed towards silly mid off as Bishoo goes to his left in the followthrough to make a good stop.
Floated on a length outside off, turning away, stays back and eases it to the left of backward point for a single.
On a length outside off, gets back and pushes it towards backward point.
Tossed up outside off, drilled towards cover but straight to the fielder.
Shortish outside off, a bit of width and Shehzad glides it down to third man for a run to keep strike.
Short of a length outside off, Hafeez rides the extra bounce and dabs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length wider outside off, steered towards short third man for a quick single.
Almost got the nick there! Good length outside off, a hint of away movement as Shehzad is beaten on the push. Excellent bowling!
Fuller around off, Hafeez bunts it towards mid on for a sharp single.
Back of a length around middle, worked off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up around middle and off, Shehzad dances down the track and lofts it over wide mid on. The deep mid-wicket fielder covers it and a brace is taken.
Served full in the line of the stumps, eased to long on for a single.
Quicker one around off, skidding in, defended from within the crease.
Full around off, driven back to the bowler.
Served outside off, spinning away, dabbed to point.
SIX! Top-spinner on middle, Hafeez steps down the track, makes room and tonks it over wide long on for a huge maximum. That will release the pressure. 100 up for Pakistan!
Bye! Well-directed short delivery. Lands it outside off, gets it to angle in sharply. Hafeez has to lean back to leave. Hope behind the stumps fumbles and concedes a bye.
Outside off, Hafeez leaves it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, defended firmly off the back foot.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Hafeez goes after it but fails to connect. A wide is signalled.
Back of a length delivery outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Full outside off, Shehzad covers his stumps and drives it back to the bowler. Holder picks the ball and has a shy back the striker's end but misses.
On a length outside off, straightens a touch after pitching. Shehzad gets squared up as he looks to defend it with the angle. Gets a leading edge to cover-point.
Sliding into the batsman, driven to mid on.
Full outside off, milked to long off for a single.
Wide! Drifts this one but it's down the leg side and a wide is signaled.
Tossed up on off, spins away sharply. Hafeez prods forward to defend but gets an outside edge past slip for a single.
Tossed up nicely on middle, pushed to covers.
Fuller on the pads, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full around off, pushed uppishly to covers.
Drinks break!
Fullish delivery outside off, pushed to covers.
Wide! Wide outside off, it's too far from the batsman and a wide is signalled.

SHOUT FOR LBW! Fuller length delivery, angling in from outside off, Shehzad gets across to clip it but misses. Gets rapped on the pads and the ball goes on the leg side. Holder and co appeal but it's turned down. He thinks of the review but his keeper says not to take it. A leg bye is taken.
Full and angling down leg, Shehzad comes down the track to flick but misses. The ball brushes the pads and goes towards Hope, who dives to his left to stop it.
Length delivery outside off, Shehzad covers his line and leaves it.
Full outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
On a length outside off, Hafeez makes a watchful leave.
In the air but safe! Tossed up around off, spinning away, Hafeez takes a stride forward to drive but checks his shot. The ball lobs towards covers and falls just away from Holder. A single is taken.

Fuller on middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket. Shehzad takes off for a quick single and completes it with a desperate dive at the bowler's end. An direct hit there would have made things interesting.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up fuller outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Short delivery, spinning away, cut behind backward point for a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
DEVENDRA BISHOO comes on to bowl.
MOHAMMAD HAFEEZ walks out at no. 3!

OUT! SOFT DISMISSAL! Pitched on a length wide outside off, nips away after landing. Akmal extends his arms, goes after the width and the ball goes straight to Walton at covers. That's really a poor dismissal as Akmal was looking settled out there. Good breakthrough for the hosts.
Length delivery outside off, punched to point.
Slightly back of a length outside off, cut to point.
Back of a length delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length delivery, angling in, defended off the front foot.
Length delivery outside off,m guided t6io third man for a single.
Served wide outside off, dabbed past point for a brace.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Sliding into the batsman, defended from within the crease.
Darts this one outside off, Akmal looks to jam it out but misses. Even the keeper fumbles but no extra conceded.
SIX! Tossed up outside off, Akmal backs away, makes room and smokes it over covers for a maximum.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
ASHLEY NURSE is into the attack.

Slightly back of a length outside off, punched on the up to cover-point. Akmal takes off for the single but is sent back. The fielder at point comes to the ball, takes aim at the striker's end but misses. A singles is taken off the overthrow. The replays show that had the throw hit, Akmal was a goner as his was nowhere in the frame.
Good length delivery around off, angling in, nips back in too after pitching. Akmal looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad.
Full and angling into the batsman, driven off the inside half to mid on.
Short delivery outside off, Shehzad gets across and pulls it behind backward square leg for a single.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to covers.
Served around middle, spinning down leg, Shehzad covers the stumps and works it uppishly but in the gap in the mid-wicket region. A single is taken.
FOUR! Again it' short outside off, Shehzad makes room and punches it through cover-point. Finds the gap and the ball races to the fence.
Tossed up around off, eased to long on for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery, punished! Short, straight and wide outside off, slapped through covers for a boundary. Akmal is looking solid out there.
Served around off, spinning in, Akmal goes back and punches it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Spinning into the batsman, Akmal nudges it to mid-wicket.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
SWING AND A MISS! Back of a length delivery outside off, Akmal looks to slash it hard but misses. Got beaten by the extra bounce there.
Good length delivery outside off, Akmal steps forward to tap and run but gets it off the inner half beside the stumps.
Length delivery outside off, gently tapped in front of covers for a single.
On a length outside off, moves away just a bit, Shehzad looks to play it on the up but is beaten all ends up. There is an appeal from the keeper but Holder isn't interested.
On the shorter side of the length, gently defended in the mid on region for a single.
JASON HOLDER comes to bowl now.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Four fielders now allowed outside the ring.
Fired in around middle, Akmal drills it down to long on for a single to keep strike.
Flatter outside off, Akmal gets back and pushes it to the off side.
Flatter on leg stump, worked away to the leg side.
FOUR! THERE HE GOES AGAIN! Floated around middle, Akmal gets across and slog sweeps it away to the deep backward square leg fence for another boundary. He is now motoring along.
Floated around off, defends it well from the crease.
FOUR! BANG! Flatter around middle, sits back and pulls it away over backward square leg. Bad ball and it was asking to be hit, Akmal just obliged.
Back of a length outside off, Shehzad taps it towards cover.

FOUR! Clipped away! Joseph strays on the pads and Shehzad feasts on it. Flicks it nicely through backward square leg to find the fence. Alzarri is probably tiring now as he is doling out quite a few freebies. This brings the the 50-run opening stand!
Back of a length outside off, blocked solidly from the crease towards cover.
Short and wide outside off, it was a gift but Shehzad's cut found the point fielder to perfection. He missed out there, it was a freebie.
Shortish outside off, stays back and pushes it to the covers.

Back of a length outside off, gets back and eases it through backward point for a brace. Good running and an equally good effort by the fielder near the ropes who covered a lot of ground from third man.
Loopy around middle, gets across and taps it gently to short fine leg.
Drifting in around leg stump, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fired in around middle, punched off the back foot down to long on for a single.
Flatter around middle, Akmal looks to sweep but cannot beat short fine leg.
SIX! LAUNCHED! Akmal uses his feet nicely to get to the pitch of this flighted ball and deposits it over long off for a maximum. Excellent nimble footwork.
Floated around middle, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the back foot towards cover.
Fuller and outside off, mistimes the drive towards mid off.
Back of a length wider outside off, Akmal tries to slash it away but he is nowhere close to the ball to make contact. Wasn't far away from being called a wide.
PLAY AND A MISS! Back of a length on the fourth stump line, Akmal tries to feel for it and is lucky not to get a feather on it.
Length ball outside off, Shehzad gets on the front foot and drives it sweetly on the up through the covers. Splits the gap and will pick up three as Holder gives chase to cut off the boundary.
FOUR! POOR BALL! Shortish around off, not the length to bowl on this pitch and Shehzad mauls the pull in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. Easy pickings.
Flighted around middle, Akmal nudges it gently towards mid-wicket. Maiden to start for Mohammed. Back-to-back maidens for West Indies.
Drifting in around middle, Akmal clips it to the leg side.
Slightly short outside off, stays back and slaps it towards cover.
Full and outside off, pushed firmly towards cover off the front foot.
Flatter around middle, sits back and pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Floated around middle, Akmal leans across and blocks it on to the pitch.
JASON MOHAMMED comes into the attack. Interesting move this.
Almost carried! Back of a length around off, Shehzad is late to close the bat face and the ball goes high of the bat towards the bowler. Just short of Joseph. Maiden over from Alzarri. Good stuff!
Shortish outside off, sits back and punches it towards cover.
Length ball very wide outside off, watchfully left alone to the keeper.
Short of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one by Shehzad.
Back of a length around off, chops it on the bounce towards the short third man region.
Shortish outside off, sits back and defends it firmly towards cover.
Back of a length outside off, Shehzad slashes at it and the ball goes off the slice down to third man. Single taken.
Good length outside off, Shehzad looks to cut but there is no room for the stroke. The ball jags back in a touch and he is beaten.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot through cover-point. There is a sweeper cover in place now and so just a single.

FOUR! SLAPPED! Shortish and outside off, width on offer and Akmal lashes the cut through point. Finds the gap with ease and that races away to the fence. He loves this area square of the wicket on the off side.
Full and outside off, Akmal presses forward and blocks firmly towards cover.
Back of a length around middle, stays back and blocks it to the leg side.
Fullish outside off, crisply driven towards mid off.
Back of a length around off, hits Shehzad high on the blade as he looks to block to cover.
FOUR! Hammered! Shortish around middle, sits up nicely for Shehzad who rocks back in a jiffy and pulls it away to the left of square leg for a boundary. Nicely struck!
FOUR! UPPISH AGAIN BUT IN THE GAP! Fuller around middle, Shezad gets across and flicks it aerially through mid-wicket. Placement was good and the ball races to the fence for a boundary.

DROPPED! Difficult chance though and these are the ones that either stick or they do not. Short of a length outside off, Shehzad flashes at it hard and gets a thickish edge that flies towards second slip where Nurse leaps to get a hand on it but fails to cling on to it. Early life for Shehzad.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to the covers.
SIX! BANG! Akmal takes full toll of the Free Hit! Shortish around middle, he just stands tall and clobbers it ferociously over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Blistering strike from Akmal.
Free Hit coming up again.
Kamran makes room by backing away but Gabriel follows him with a bouncer. Too high and wide called. So, the Free Hit stays.
Free Hit coming up.
This time the no ball is called. Fuller ball outside off, Akmal drives firmly towards extra cover. Gabriel has overstepped.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Full and a hint of width outside off, Akmal plays a scorching drive through cover-point. Timed it so well that it raced away to the fence in no time. Gabriel had overstepped but nobody spotted it.
Length ball wider outside off, Akmal mistimes the drive towards mid off.
Good length around off, 145 kph, Shehzad is hurried by the pace and gets an inside edge on to the pads as the ball rolls to the leg side. Single taken.
Fuller outside off, Shehzad bunts it firmly back to the bowler.

HUGE APPEAL! Lovely inswinger from Gabriel and Shehzad is rapped on the pads as he looks to play across the line. Loud lbw shout but it's turned down. WI decide to review after a long chat but the umpire informs Holder that the stipulated 15 seconds is up. Replays show that it was missing leg stump, so the Windies got saved by the time up.
SHANNON GABRIEL to take the other new ball.
Back of a length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
BEATEN! That's a probing line from Joseph. Back of a length outside off, a bit of shape away late as the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Shehzad is lucky not to get an edge there.
Good length outside off, gets a stride forward and opens the bat face to steer it towards point.
Short of a length closer to off, Shehzad gets right behind the line and defends firmly down the track.
Back of a length outside off, Shehzad dabs it towards the gully region. Wants the single but is sent back. Direct hit at the keeper's end and the ball rebounds towards mid-wicket. No run taken.
Good length outside off, Shehzad stays back to that one and taps it gently towards cover-point.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. AHMED SHEHZAD and KAMRAN AKMAL to open the batting for Pakistan. It shall be ALZARRI JOSEPH to open the bowling for West Indies. Two slips in place, here we go!

SARFRAZ AHMED hopes that his side can put a good total on the board. Says that it is an honor to be appointed the full time limited-overs captain of Pakistan. States that the guys are confident after the T20I series and hopes his team can carry forward the momentum. Reveals that SHADAB KHAN IS MAKING HIS ODI DEBUT and that Mohammad Amir is back.

JASON HOLDER says that they will bowl first. Feels that there is a bit of moisture beneath the surface which is freshly laid. Agrees that it's difficult to predict how the new pitch will behave. Accepts that each game is important from now on with the World Cup qualification a target for both teams. Says that they are going with three pacers and two spinners.
TOSS - WEST INDIES WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD.

The hosts on the other hand are a completely different side from the one that played the T20I series. They would hope that this young team fires for them and take the revenge of their embarrassing whitewash in the ODIs in the Gulf. The weather forecast for this match doesn't look too optimistic as showers are predicted in the earlier part of the game. Let's hope that the skies stay clear and we have a cracker of a match on our hands. Toss coming up shortly.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI between West Indies and Pakistan in Guyana. The visitors have started this tour positively by winning the 4-match T20I series 3-1. They would look to continue their good form against the Men from the Caribbean by registering another win today. Their bowlers were the ones who stood out and created havoc in the T20Is. Especially the young leggie Shadab Khan, who was exceptional.
